turns.prompt: Add a truncate(str, n) function to src/str.js that cuts the string to n characters and appends an ellipsis character when it cuts. Add tests and run them.
texts: I'll look at the existing file and test setup first.

`ISSUE.md` in this repo describes a different task (`slugify`) — I'm doing what you asked (`truncate`), not that.

One ambiguity worth flagging: "cuts to n characters and appends an ellipsis" can mean the result is n chars total (ellipsis included) or n+1. I'm taking the literal reading — slice to n, then append — so `truncate('abcdef', 3)` is `'abc…'` (4 chars). Say the word if you want the budget to include the ellipsis.
